description: Topics: registry, network, sovereignty, multi-user. The owner noted the registry now serves several repositories over MCP only and is drifting from local use toward network exposure; asked whether REST has value beside MCP, whether authentication can be added without bloat while keeping sovereign principles, and whether multi-user access forces an SQL backend; set srs-lab as the place for experiments that must not undermine the system.
title: 2026-11-04 · Exposing the registry on a network: REST beside MCP, authentication, sovereignty, multi-user and SQL
